observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor room with tiled floor, likely a dance studio or community hall, during a group dance class.
observation.dancers: Approximately 12-14 dancers, mixed gender, dancing in pairs.
observation.formation_and_space: The dancers form a circle, moving around the center, frequently changing partners and positions.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, including side-steps, weight changes, and pivots, consistent with salsa/casino style. The exact footwork is difficult to see due to camera angle and movement.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms are frequently raised, held, or extended, with partners holding hands or arms, and sometimes releasing to perform individual turns or movements.
observation.hips_and_torso: Continuous movement of the hips and torso, with rhythmic isolations and rotations.
observation.partnering: Close contact, frequent partner changes, lead and follow dynamics.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Includes turns, spins, and occasional drops or floor-level movements.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual clothing, including tank tops, t-shirts, jeans, and athletic pants.
observation.cannot_infer: The fast-paced movement and frequent partner changes make it difficult to see individual footwork clearly. The camera angle and distance also limit the ability to see specific details of the dancers' movements.
